title: Winning concept specified: 'GATE AND LANTERN' (K5 + grafts) — all 26 juror objections resolved; Sejmik storey now fits with a lobby corridor; 14,151 m² GFA, 146.2 M PLN incl. 5 % reserve
stages: Site ✔ (zoning, heritage, survey, geotech, trees, neighbours)
Design research ✔ (trends, visuals, boards, façades, costs)
Concept → 3 verifiers ✔ → revision v1.1 ► (spec + Sejmik S-2)
Production ►: all drawings ✔ incl. 12 plans 1:200; 3D tests ✔; finals after v1.1
Boards ►: Stage I 2/2 drafts, Stage II 5/8 drafts; tables ►
Audit ►: completeness 25/44; structural & functional audit ►; jury later
notes: User asked to keep structural and functional correctness in focus → a dedicated multi-agent audit runs: structure & load paths, foundations & groundwater, fire & evacuation, circulation & lift capacity, office programme, garage & building services; each finding verified by a skeptic and an engineer.

Plans 1:200 for all 12 levels with axes, dimension chains, room numbers & areas, section lines, legends; all 187 offices placed (179 × 24 m² + 8 × 32 m²), accessible WC and refuge areas on every storey.

Hard problem confirmed by the plans agent: even an ideal layout of the current underground gives ≤ ≈ 92 parking spaces vs ≥ 101 required by the local plan (12/1000 m² PU). Causes are structural (tower column grid, central cores, ramps, plant rooms) → garage redesign is now a hard item of revision v1.1.
Also from the plans: column lines v 8.10 / 21.60 fall in corridors (shift ≈ 0.5 m), the 15.0 m wing tract cannot fit corridor walls, storeys 5–6 are over capacity by 2 units.

3D: full building model with granite, 4-tone ceramics, BIPV roofs, context and people; honest assessment: test renders are clean but not yet competition-grade (flat light, monotone stone, weak glass reflections). Next: photomatch on F.17.A/B, reflections from the organiser's site panoramas, interior of the Citizens' Hall, wheelchair user in vis 3.
